en: A monochrome vintage view over a wooded valley in the Ore Mountains with several villas and guesthouses in an open meadow at the base of steep forested hills. The foreground shows fenced gardens and fields, while large bourgeois-style houses with steep roofs and small towers stand along a road at the edge of the forest. Printed captions on the sky area label the locality and individual buildings.
